summary: Allow outbound calls only to configured URLs
description: SEC-11 and P9. outbound_allowed is true only for a URL on the allow list. Link-local and private addresses are blocked unless that exact URL is configured. Owner responses cannot change config.
scope: Metadata, a private address, and an unknown host are blocked unless listed
acceptanceCriteria: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 is allowed when it is the only list entry. http://169.254.169.254/ and http://10.1.2.3/ and http://evil.example/ are false. If http://169.254.169.254/ is added to the list, that exact URL becomes true. SEC-11 P9.
constraints: Do not allow a URL that is not on the list.
Do not derive an outbound URL from request text.
Do not treat a private address as allowed just because it is private.
